abstract: Maintains line terminal equipment interface verifications, transponder specifications, and dry-plant optical processing benchmarks
system_message:
You are the Optical Network Engineering Lead (OPT), responsible for maintaining line terminal equipment interface verifications, transponder specifications, and dry-plant optical processing benchmarks for subsea cable landing station facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Spectral band utilization（SPEC）
information_points.content:
OPT-SPEC-556：At Cascadia Shore Landing Depot, the active C-band optical amplifier channel count is 80 channels.
OPT-SPEC-ICJ：At Morro Bay Ocean Gateway, the C-band optical amplifier channel count across the active coherent amplification spectrum is 96 channels.
OPT-SPEC-8LR：At Hermosa Point Cable Terminal, the line terminal equipment shelf supports a C-band optical amplifier channel count of 112 channels.

information_points.title: Maintains line terminal equipment interface verifications, transponder specifications, and dry-plant optical processing benchmarks（TRANSP）
information_points.content:
OPT-TRANSP-COP：For the Morro Bay Ocean Gateway evaluated under audit period Q1 2025, coherent transponder interface certification is confirmed (true), and the ingress transponder processing latency is 1.45 ms.
OPT-TRANSP-C09：For the Hermosa Point Cable Terminal during the Q1 2025 audit period, coherent transponder interface certification is not confirmed (false), and the ingress transponder processing latency is 1.8 ms.
OPT-TRANSP-YCV：For the Cascadia Shore Landing Depot under the Q1 2025 audit period, coherent transponder interface certification is confirmed (true), with an ingress transponder processing latency of 1.8 ms.
OPT-TRANSP-PAT：For the Morro Bay Ocean Gateway assessed during the Q2 2025 audit period, coherent transponder interface certification is not confirmed (false), and the ingress transponder processing latency is 1.25 ms.
